Done. Summary:

**What changed in `job.json`:**
- Added `img/03-dashboard-language-english.png` and `img/04-default-text-japanese-prefill.png` back as their own entries in `steps[]`, using the original raw captures as `src` and the existing annotated files as `out` (unchanged paths), so both images can now be opened individually in KB Studio's editor.
- Reconstructed their `els` exactly from the last known state before they were folded into Step 2's body: image 03 gets `highlight` + `step` + `arrow` on the Language dropdown; image 04 gets `highlight` on the pre-filled field + `zoom` inset on "Box items title".
- To keep the article's visible structure exactly as it is now (no new `## N.` heading, images still appearing inside Step 2's "Optional" block, in the same order, with the same surrounding prose), I split Step 2's merged body at the two points where those images were previously inlined, and moved that surrounding text into the new entries' own `body` fields (numbered items "1. On the Dashboard…" and "2. Open Content & Translation again…"), plus moved the closing "switch back to English" `Note` onto the new Japanese-prefill entry, where it already sat. Both new entries use `n: 2` (same as their parent "Edit the default text (English)" step) and an empty `heading`, so they extend that step's content rather than starting a new numbered section.
- Ran `snap_render_job` — all 5 images re-rendered without any WARNING output (no overflow, no duplicate-`n` complaint).

**Verified by `snap_view`:** `03-dashboard-language-english-annotated.png`, `04-default-text-japanese-prefill-annotated.png`, `02-default-text-english-annotated.png`, and `03-translation-french-annotated.png` — all four match their prior appearance pixel-for-pixel in placement (same highlight/step/arrow/zoom positions), PII blur still present on every one.

**One caveat I can't verify from this session:** this "revise" job has no tool that reads the compiled `.md` text (only `snap_job` for the JSON and `snap_view` for images), so I can't directly confirm the final assembled markdown doesn't emit a stray empty `## 2. ` line for the two headless entries — I'm relying on the renderer conditionally skipping the heading line when `heading` is empty, which held true for this render (no warnings, and the job write itself accepted duplicate `n: 2` values without complaint). If KB Studio's preview shows any blank heading gap or the images landing in the wrong place relative to the "1./2." text, flag it and I'll adjust immediately — the next re-read will show me the real compiled markdown either way.
